package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	"github.com/bahadrdsr/aspm/internal/app"
)

type input struct {
	DatabaseURL, Schema, ApplicationName, BootstrapToken, Password, ViewerPassword string
	StorageEndpoint, Bucket, Prefix, AccessKey, SecretKey, Report                  string
	Now                                                                            time.Time
}
type actor struct {
	User      app.User
	Workspace string
	Cookie    *http.Cookie
}
type envelope struct {
	User      app.User
	Workspace app.Workspace
	Asset     app.Asset
	Import    app.Import
	Finding   app.Finding
	Items     []app.WorkItem
}
type countedConn struct {
	net.Conn
	writes *atomic.Int32
}

func (c countedConn) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
	if c.writes.Add(1) > 40 {
		return 0, errors.New("published intake I/O budget exceeded")
	}
	return c.Conn.Write(b)
}
func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
func run() error {
	var in input
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 256<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&in) != nil || !regexp.MustCompile(`^work_views_[a-f0-9]{24}$`).MatchString(in.Schema) ||
		in.Prefix != "saved-work-views/"+strings.TrimPrefix(in.Schema, "work_views_")+"/" || in.Now.IsZero() {
		return errors.New("published seed rejected unowned input; private details withheld")
	}
	database, err := url.Parse(in.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil || database.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || database.Port() != "15432" || database.User == nil {
		return errors.New("published seed rejected database boundary")
	}
	endpoint, err := url.Parse(in.StorageEndpoint)
	if err != nil || endpoint.Scheme != "http" || endpoint.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || endpoint.Port() != "18333" {
		return errors.New("published seed rejected storage boundary")
	}
	var writes, blocked atomic.Int32
	transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	transport.Proxy = nil
	transport.DialContext = func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
		if address != endpoint.Host {
			blocked.Add(1)
			return nil, errors.New("published seed forbids non-intake HTTP")
		}
		conn, err := (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, network, address)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return countedConn{conn, &writes}, nil
	}
	http.DefaultTransport = transport
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 25*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	const origin = "https://saved-work-views.synthetic.invalid"
	core, err := app.Open(ctx, app.Config{DatabaseURL: in.DatabaseURL, Schema: in.Schema,
		ApplicationName: in.ApplicationName, MaxConnections: 2, BootstrapToken: in.BootstrapToken,
		ManualProcessing: true, PublicOrigin: origin, MaxUploadBytes: 64 << 10, SessionTTL: time.Hour,
		Now: func() time.Time { return in.Now }, LogOutput: io.Discard,
		Storage: app.StorageConfig{Endpoint: in.StorageEndpoint, Bucket: in.Bucket, Prefix: in.Prefix,
			AccessKey: in.AccessKey, SecretKey: in.SecretKey, Region: "us-east-1", Timeout: 5 * time.Second}})
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("exact published V8 app.Open failed; private details withheld")
	}
	defer core.Close()
	workspace, calls := "", 0
	var cookie *http.Cookie
	request := func(method, path string, body any, status int) (envelope, error) {
		calls++
		if calls > 24 {
			return envelope{}, errors.New("published API budget exceeded")
		}
		data, err := json.Marshal(body)
		if err != nil {
			return envelope{}, errors.New("published request encoding failed")
		}
		req := httptest.NewRequest(method, origin+path, bytes.NewReader(data)).WithContext(ctx)
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("Origin", origin)
		req.Header.Set("X-ASPM-Workspace-ID", workspace)
		if cookie != nil {
			req.AddCookie(cookie)
		}
		if path == "/api/v1/bootstrap" {
			req.Header.Set("X-ASPM-Bootstrap-Token", in.BootstrapToken)
		}
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		core.Handler.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != status {
			return envelope{}, fmt.Errorf("published %s %s returned %d, want %d; response withheld", method, path, response.Code, status)
		}
		var out envelope
		if json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &out) != nil {
			return out, errors.New("published API response encoding failed")
		}
		for _, value := range response.Result().Cookies() {
			if value.Name == "aspm_session" {
				cookie = value
			}
		}
		return out, nil
	}
	enrolled, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/bootstrap", map[string]any{"workspaceName": "Actual published V8",
		"name": "Legacy owner", "email": "legacy@views.invalid", "password": in.Password}, 201)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	workspace = enrolled.Workspace.ID
	session, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/login", map[string]string{"email": "legacy@views.invalid", "password": in.Password}, 200)
	if err != nil || cookie == nil {
		return errors.New("published admin login failed")
	}
	admin := actor{session.User, workspace, cookie}
	if _, err = request("POST", "/api/v1/users", map[string]any{"name": "Legacy viewer", "email": "viewer@views.invalid",
		"password": in.ViewerPassword, "role": "viewer"}, 201); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	asset, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/assets", map[string]any{"name": "Published V8 repository", "kind": "repository",
		"environment": "test", "criticality": "medium", "tags": []string{"synthetic"}, "ownerId": admin.User.ID}, 201)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	queued, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/imports", map[string]any{"apiVersion": app.APIVersion, "assetId": asset.Asset.ID,
		"format": "sarif", "report": in.Report, "sourceId": "published-v8-source", "scanId": "published-v8-scan",
		"scope":        app.Scope{ID: asset.Asset.ID, Revision: "1", Branch: "refs/heads/main"},
		"sourceScanAt": in.Now.Add(-time.Hour), "collectedAt": in.Now,
		"sourceStatus": "succeeded", "scanKind": "full", "completeness": "complete"}, 202)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if core.ProcessImports(ctx) != nil {
		return errors.New("published real S3 intake failed")
	}
	completed, err := request("GET", "/api/v1/imports/"+queued.Import.ID, nil, 200)
	if err != nil || completed.Import.State != "succeeded" || completed.Import.ObservationCount != 1 {
		return errors.New("published real finding intake did not complete")
	}
	work, err := request("GET", "/api/v1/work", nil, 200)
	if err != nil || len(work.Items) != 1 {
		return errors.New("published real Work identity missing")
	}
	id := work.Items[0].ID
	if _, err = request("PATCH", "/api/v1/findings/"+id, map[string]any{"workflowState": "in-progress", "ownerId": admin.User.ID}, 200); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = request("POST", "/api/v1/findings/"+id+"/notes", map[string]string{"text": "Actual published V8 human note."}, 201); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	session, err = request("POST", "/api/v1/login", map[string]string{"email": "viewer@views.invalid", "password": in.ViewerPassword}, 200)
	if err != nil || cookie == nil {
		return errors.New("published viewer login failed")
	}
	viewer := actor{session.User, workspace, cookie}
	finding, err := request("GET", "/api/v1/findings/"+id, nil, 200)
	if err != nil || len(finding.Finding.Notes) != 1 || blocked.Load() != 0 {
		return errors.New("published legacy read or native boundary failed")
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		Admin, Viewer actor
		Asset         app.Asset
		Import        app.Import
		Finding       app.Finding
		APICalls      int
		StorageWrites int32
	}{admin, viewer, asset.Asset, completed.Import, finding.Finding, calls, writes.Load()})
}
